newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says to cut meat imports 37 pct to 34,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Iran says to cut meat imports 37 pct to 34,000 T.

text.p: Iran will import 34,000 tonnes of red meat in the year to March 1998, down 37 percent from the previous year, Iranian news agency IRNA said Friday.

It quoted Abbasali Motallebi, head of the the state Veterinary Organisation, as saying the country would cut red meat imports by 20,000 tonnes to 34,000 tonnes in the current Iranian year which ends on March 20, 1998.
He said domestic red meat production was 640,000 tonnes last year, the agency added. The report did not name the countries from which Iran would import meat.
